listing.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Duelists of the Roses — dotr-recomp (Glasena)
listing.original_game_title: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Duelists of the Roses
listing.summary: Build this early Yu-Gi-Oh! The Duelists of the Roses port locally on Linux using your USA disc. Upstream describes movie, story, duel and map support. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA NTSC-U SLUS20515 ISO. Extract SLUS_205.15 and SYSTEM.CNF, then recompile the DATA/*MODULE.MRG overlays locally using the upstream instructions.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: No ready-to-use release is offered. Follow the local Linux build instructions with CMake, Ghidra and files extracted from your own disc.

warnings: Upstream describes early movie, story, duel and map support. Its build and testing cover only the USA disc on Linux; Portcove has not confirmed gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
